text: {"label":"Communication and Conversation Training in Autism","definition":"Teaching language and communication to autistic children, adolescents, and adults, including speech-generating devices, verbal operants, instructive feedback, second-language learning, functional communication training, and conversational skills.","distinct_from_neighbours":"It covers broad communication modes, including devices and adult conversation, unlike the social-skills and video-modeling focus of topic 13, the intraverbal and vocalization work of topic 46, and general skill acquisition in topic 162."}
